page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead GCP DevOps & Cloud Migration Engineer
headline: Lead GCP DevOps Engineer | Cloud Migration, Terraform, GKE, CI/CD & Landing Zone Architecture
summary_html: Lead GCP DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and operating enterprise cloud platforms across Google Cloud and hybrid environments. Specialized in consolidating ungoverned cloud projects into centralized landing zones using Terraform, Shared VPC, and Organization Policy governance. Proven ability to standardize CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitLab CI), deliver production GKE platforms, and harden multi-project environments through VPC Service Controls and least-privilege IAM.

achievements.text: Led end-to-end migration of Shadow IT and standalone GCP projects into a centralized greenfield landing zone, establishing Organization hierarchy, folder structure, and Organization Policy Constraints to enforce governance at scale.
Architected reusable Terraform module libraries for GCP resource provisioning, enforcing consistent project factory patterns, IAM bindings, and network configurations across 40+ migrated projects.
Designed and standardized CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, Jenkins, and GitLab CI with automated security scanning, container image validation, and policy-gated deployments across GKE clusters.
Delivered production-grade GKE clusters with Workload Identity, Autopilot node management, and Binary Authorization to secure container workloads across multi-environment delivery tiers.
Hardened GCP platform security through VPC Service Controls, Security Command Center, Organization Policy enforcement, and least-privilege IAM design across consolidated multi-project environments.

experience.title: Lead GCP DevOps Engineer
impact: Led the consolidation of 40+ ungoverned and independently managed GCP projects into an enterprise landing zone, establishing Organization hierarchy, folder structure, and policy governance at scale.

Architected and maintained a Terraform module library for GCP project factory provisioning, automating the creation of projects, Shared VPC attachments, IAM role bindings, Cloud NAT, and firewall rules with zero manual console access.

Designed and implemented Shared VPC network architecture across the landing zone, configuring subnet-level IAM, Private Google Access, Cloud NAT gateways, and firewall policies to enforce network segmentation between migrated workloads.

Standardized CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build and GitLab CI with automated Terraform plan/apply workflows, container vulnerability scanning via Artifact Registry, and policy-gated deployment approvals for GKE target clusters.

Deployed production-grade GKE clusters with Workload Identity, node pool auto-scaling, Binary Authorization for container image validation, and namespace-level RBAC to support multi-tenant application delivery.
Implemented VPC Service Controls and Organization Policy Constraints to restrict resource creation, enforce location policies, and prevent data exfiltration across consolidated GCP projects.
Automated cloud infrastructure compliance auditing using Security Command Center findings, custom Python scripts, and Cloud Functions to detect and remediate policy drift across the landing zone.

Orchestrated cross-team migration planning sessions with application owners, documenting dependency maps, network connectivity requirements, and IAM migration paths for each standalone project cutover.

experience.title: Senior GCP DevOps Engineer
impact: Deployed and administered GKE Standard and Autopilot clusters, configuring Workload Identity, pod security policies, and Istio service mesh for secure microservice communication.
Migrated legacy Jenkins pipelines to GitLab CI with GKE-hosted runners, implementing reusable pipeline templates, container image scanning, and branch-protection-gated deployments.

Provisioned GCP infrastructure using Terraform modules with GCS remote state, enforcing consistent project layouts, VPC configurations, and IAM bindings across development and production environments.
Implemented Cloud Build triggers for automated Terraform validation, plan, and apply workflows with integrated security scanning and Slack notification for infrastructure change approvals.
Hardened GKE cluster security through Binary Authorization policies, container image allowlisting, and Artifact Registry vulnerability scanning to enforce supply chain integrity.

Collaborated with application teams to re-platform containerized workloads from standalone projects into the centralized GCP environment, standardizing logging via Cloud Logging and monitoring via Cloud Monitoring.

experience.title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
impact: Designed multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows using Terraform, supporting both GCP and AWS environments with shared module patterns, remote state management in GCS, and environment-specific variable injection.
Automated GKE cluster provisioning and lifecycle management through Terraform, including node pool configuration, network policy enforcement, and integrated Cloud Monitoring dashboards.
Built CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build and Jenkins, automating the continuous delivery of containerized Python, Node.js, and Java artifacts to GKE clusters across multiple environments.
Implemented Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring observability stacks with custom metrics, log-based alerts, and SLO dashboards to support proactive incident response and platform reliability.
Authored reusable Python and Bash automation scripts for GCP project onboarding, IAM audit reporting, and Terraform state management, standardizing operational tooling across engineering teams.
Designed secure VPC networking with Cloud NAT, Private Google Access, Cloud Interconnect, and firewall rule hierarchies for enterprise workloads migrating to GCP.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Designed CI/CD automation for GCP and AWS environments using Jenkins and Cloud Build, integrating SonarQube code quality gates and container vulnerability scanning into deployment workflows.
Delivered a repeatable Terraform and Kubernetes framework for GCP-hosted payment platform deployments, enforcing infrastructure compliance and disaster recovery readiness.
Developed custom internal APIs using Python (FastAPI) to integrate Jenkins, Jira, and Artifact Registry workflows, automating project onboarding and release pipeline provisioning.
Authored and enforced GCP IAM security controls with Organization-level policies, service account key rotation automation, and Workload Identity Federation for cross-project access management.
Built custom Prometheus exporters in Python to capture application-specific operational metrics, feeding Cloud Monitoring and Grafana dashboards for real-time SRE observability.
Standardized Helm chart packaging and GKE deployment patterns for microservices, ensuring consistent runtime behavior across development, staging, and production namespaces.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Executed large-scale workload migrations from on-premises environments to GCP and AWS, utilizing Terraform-driven modernization strategies for enterprise applications and relational databases.
Built continuous delivery pipelines using Jenkins and Cloud Build, supporting containerized microservice deployments across Sandbox, UAT, and Production environments on GKE.
Architected enterprise monitoring and logging pipelines using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and the ELK stack, delivering critical visibility into infrastructure health and security events.
Managed Helm-based release packaging and deployed production Kubernetes workloads on GKE with namespace isolation, resource quotas, and network policy enforcement.
Automated configuration drift detection and remediation for cloud infrastructure using Terraform plan diffs and custom Shell scripts, enforcing enterprise baseline security standards.
Acted as technical liaison between cross-functional teams in India and Germany, presenting cloud migration strategies, landing zone architectures, and DevOps roadmaps to secure stakeholder alignment.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Created deployment pipelines with Jenkins and Ansible to promote releases from development through production in a controlled, repeatable manner across cloud environments.
Authored and maintained Terraform modules for cloud infrastructure provisioning across GCP and AWS, executing infrastructure changes through automated CI/CD workflows with versioned remote state.
Built YAML-based CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI using event-driven triggers, container builds, and automated testing to support continuous integration on every code change.
Executed cloud proof-of-concepts for workload migration, delivering solution designs aligned to application architecture requirements and enterprise governance patterns.
Defined and implemented branching strategies, artifact versioning standards, and pipeline governance policies to improve release quality and traceability across engineering teams.
Documented cloud migration runbooks, Terraform module usage guides, and deployment flows for infrastructure, API, and database components to improve team onboarding and operational consistency.
